subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils 2/7] nfsdctl: probe the policy of any command

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the nfsdctl utility to probe the policy of any command, not just THREADS_SET. It introduces a new function query_nfsd_nl_cmd_policy() that takes the command number as an argument and writes the highest attribute through its callback argument. The original query_nfsd_nl_policy() function is preserved for backwards compatibility and still probes THREADS_SET. No functional changes are made, but the code is refactored to make it more flexible and reusable.
